room_rent.note: Single room cap applies for SI up to 10L; proportionate clause applies if higher room taken

icu.note: Fixed daily cap for SI up to 10L; actuals for SI above 10L

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording

sub_limits.display: Cataract (₹50k/eye ≤10L; ₹1L/eye >10L), AYUSH (25% of SI), Modern Tx (25% of SI ≤10L), Mental illness (50% of SI ≤10L), Domiciliary (10% of SI, max ₹50k)
sub_limits.note: Multiple sub-limits: cataract, AYUSH, modern treatments, mental illness, domiciliary hospitalisation, telemedicine, ambulance

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible; 3-day deductible applies only for domiciliary and daily hospital cash

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 12 months continuous coverage; no optional reduction mentioned

specific_disease_waiting.note: Hypertension and diabetes have 90-day wait if not pre-existing; most surgical conditions 2 years; ENT/hernia 1 year

maternity.display: Covered under Premium Plan (24mo wait); up to ₹50k-₹1L per delivery
maternity.note: Premium Plan only; 24-month continuous coverage required; limited to 2 deliveries/terminations lifetime; pre/post-natal OPD not covered; ART also available under Premium Plan with 36mo wait

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% increase per claim-free year; reduced at same rate if claim made; max 100% of base SI

restoration.note: No sum insured restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 45 days prior to admission

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 90 days from discharge

day_care.note: Day care covered for listed procedures in Appendix I; not all day-care procedures

domiciliary.note: Covered if patient cannot be moved or no hospital room available; treatment must exceed 3 days; several diseases excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension etc.)

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to 25% of SI in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: Donor expenses covered when insured is recipient (up to SI); when insured is donor, up to 10% of SI; 12-month continuous coverage required for donor benefit

ambulance.display: Up to ₹5k/trip; ₹15k/policy (≤10L SI); higher for larger SI
ambulance.note: Road ambulance: ₹5k/occurrence, ₹15k/policy period (≤10L); ₹10k/₹20k (15-25L); ₹25k/₹50k (>25L). Air ambulance also covered (10%-25% of SI or actuals) once in policy lifetime

modern_treatments.display: Sub-limited (25% of SI for ≤10L; actuals for >10L)
modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered including robotic surgery, oral chemo, stem cell therapy etc.; sub-limit applies for SI up to 10L

consumables.note: Consumables (gloves, syringes etc.) explicitly excluded per Appendix III List I; no rider available

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment in India only; overseas treatment excluded (clause 4.38)

moratorium.note: After 8 continuous years no look-back except fraud and permanent exclusions; applies separately to enhanced SI portions

grace_period.note: 30-day grace period for renewal; no coverage during grace period

free_look.note: 15-day free-look on new policies only; not on renewals or portability

portability.note: Apply at least 45 days before renewal; accrued waiting period credits transferred per IRDAI guidelines

notable_exclusions.display: OPD expenses, dental (unless injury), spectacles/hearing aids, hormone therapy, external congenital anomaly, vaccination, permanently excluded diseases (15 ICD groups incl. cancer, epilepsy, heart disease)

optional_riders.display: Premium Plan add-on: Daily Hospital Cash (₹500-₹1000/day), Medical Second Opinion, Maternity (₹50k-₹1L), Assisted Reproduction Treatment (₹2L lifetime)
